standard_prerequisites.use: Constructs the invertible module det(L-bullet) over an affine base.

standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-quasi-coherence-pullback (same chapter, NOT carded, declared external)
standard_prerequisites.use: Underlies the compatibility det(L) tensor B = det(L tensor B) for affine opens V inside U.

core_obligations: For an affine open U = Spec(A), the restriction L|_U corresponds to a perfect complex L-bullet of A-modules with tor amplitude in [-1, 0]; take det(L-bullet) from the module-level construction.
Compatibility with restriction: for V = Spec(B) inside U, det(L-bullet) tensor_A B = det(L-bullet tensor_A B) since A -> B is flat; the construction glues to an invertible module det(L) on X.

Functoriality on isomorphisms: for an isomorphism a: L -> K, the affine-local determinants of the induced maps glue; carry the verification that the gluing is compatible with restriction as an explicit obligation (source: 'constructed in exactly the same manner. Details omitted.').

Canonical sections: the module-level canonical element delta(L-bullet) in Gamma(U, det(L-bullet)) glues to delta(L) in Gamma(X, det(L)); carry the compatibility delta(K) = det(a)(delta(L)) under the same gluing as an explicit obligation.
Affine-local agreement with the More on Algebra construction is built into step (1); state it as part of the construction.
proof_roadmap: Affine-local construction; gluing by flat base-change compatibility; functoriality obligation; canonical-section obligation.
difficulty_reason: A gluing construction with two explicit obligations for the parallel functoriality and canonical-section parts that the source marks 'same manner, details omitted'.
